description: This file defines the StreamStageConfig interface, including methods for retrieving parallelism settings and back-off configurations, along with an internal enum for default configuration values.

classes.name: StreamStageConfig
classes.description: Interface providing configuration settings for stream stages, including parallelism and back-off configurations.

nested_classes.name: StreamStageConfigValue
nested_classes.description: Enumeration of known configuration path expressions and their default values for StreamStageConfig.

methods.name: getParallelism
methods.description: Returns the maximum number of parallel operations to perform.

methods.name: getExponentialBackOffConfig
methods.description: Returns the configuration for exponential back-off in case of failures.
